name: Vite Coupon & Voucher for WooCommerce – Coupons, Gift Cards & POS Discounts
author: appsbd

sections.description:
Vite Coupon & Voucher is an advanced coupon and gift voucher manager for WooCommerce. Create percentage discounts, fixed discounts, product discounts, free product offers and BOGO (buy one get one) deals, then sell prepaid gift vouchers your customers can redeem at checkout.

The plugin works two ways:

  • With WooCommerce alone – every coupon and voucher works on your online store, no other plugin required.
  • With VitePOS – the same coupons and vouchers are available at your point of sale counter, with per-outlet targeting so a promotion can run in one shop and not another.

Coupon features

  • Multiple coupon types – discount percentage, fixed discount, product discount, free product, and BOGO (buy one get one).
  • Percentage up to limit – cap a percentage discount at a maximum amount.
  • Coupon rules – minimum and maximum spend, include or exclude specific products and categories, and restrict a coupon to allowed email addresses.
  • Usage limits – limit usage per coupon and per customer.
  • Coupon scheduler – run a coupon only on chosen days and time ranges, for happy hour and weekend campaigns.
  • Expiry control – set a start and end date, or mark a coupon as never expiring.
  • Coupon categories – group coupons so large campaigns stay organised.
  • Outlet targeting (VitePOS) – make a coupon valid in all outlets or only in selected ones.
  • Usage tracking – see how often each coupon was used and how it performs.

Gift voucher features

  • Sell vouchers as products – create a voucher product with a fixed voucher amount and sell it like any other WooCommerce product.
  • Automatic voucher codes – a unique redeemable code is generated when a voucher product is purchased.
  • Single use or multi use – choose whether a voucher code can be redeemed once or up to a usage limit you set.
  • Expiry from purchase date – optionally expire a voucher a set number of days after it is bought, or let it never expire.
  • Redeem online and in store – the same voucher code works at WooCommerce checkout and at the VitePOS counter.
  • Voucher management – list, edit, enable, disable or delete voucher products from one screen.

Who is it for

Shops running online promotions, retail counters using WooCommerce as the backend, restaurants and cafes selling gift cards, and any store that wants coupons and store credit managed in one place instead of two plugins.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the vite-coupon folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it from the WordPress plugin directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Go to the Vite Coupon menu in wp-admin to configure settings, create coupons and set up voucher products.
  5. (Optional) Install VitePOS if you also want to use your coupons and vouchers at the point of sale counter.
sections.faq:
Do I need VitePOS to use this plugin?

No. Vite Coupon & Voucher works with WooCommerce on its own. VitePOS is optional – when it is installed, the same coupons and vouchers also work at your point of sale counter and you get outlet based targeting.

Does it work with WooCommerce coupons I already created?

Yes. Coupons are stored as native WooCommerce coupons, so your existing coupons keep working and simply gain the extra rules this plugin adds.

What is the difference between a coupon and a voucher?

A coupon is a promotional code you hand out to give a discount. A voucher (gift card) is a product a customer buys for a set amount; a unique code is generated on purchase and can be redeemed later against an order.

Can a gift voucher be used more than once?

Yes. Each voucher product can be set to single use, or to multi use with a usage limit you choose.

Do vouchers expire?

Only if you want them to. Enable expiry on a voucher product and set the number of days from the purchase date; otherwise the voucher stays valid.

Can I run a coupon only on certain days or hours?

Yes. The coupon scheduler lets you pick the days and time ranges when a coupon is active.

Is Vite Coupon compatible with other WooCommerce extensions?

Yes, it is built on native WooCommerce coupons and integrates well with most WooCommerce extensions.

How can I track the performance of my coupons?

The coupon list shows usage statistics for each coupon so you can see which campaigns are working.

How can I report security bugs?

You can report security bugs through the Patchstack Vulnerability Disclosure Program. The Patchstack team helps validate, triage and handle any security vulnerabilities. Report a security vulnerability.
